canonical_claim: Let M be a complete n-dimensional Riemannian manifold with Ricci curvature bounded below by (n-1)k. For each p in M, the ratio Vol(B(p,r))/V_k(r), where V_k(r) is the radius-r ball volume in the simply connected n-dimensional constant-sectional-curvature k model, is nonincreasing in r on its source-valid radius domain.
